name: Locked image
description: Pin a character image to the top of the chat column. The frame stays visible as chat scrolls underneath; as you scroll up through history, the frame swaps to show the image attached to whichever message is currently next to it. Image source is each message's image_pack_pick.image_url (the same picker the inline image-pack widget uses). Inline per-message images are hidden — the locked frame is the canonical image surface.

settings.label: Frame height (px)
settings.help: Optional pixel override for the frame height. Default (unset) uses a 50vh cap so the bottom half of the viewport stays for chat. Set a number to lock to a specific pixel height instead.
